messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about HISTORY and Income, property and investment/saving in Germany during the 1910s and 1920s and 1930s and 1940s and 1950s and 1960s and 1970s and 1980s and 1990s and 2000s, matching this research need: German time-series data on wages, salaries, paid weekly hours, and collective bargaining pay indices by industry, gender, and worker type, covering effective and tariff earnings from pre-1945 to 2008.
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.
